faq.a1: Once the order is delivered and the payment confirmed, cashback lands on your Ozio card within 24 hours. You can see the balance in “Card and bonus”.
faq.a2: The delivery fee is calculated by the server from the store's zone and the order total. You see the exact amount in the cart and at checkout.
faq.a3: Your digital card is always in the app — show the barcode from “Card and bonus” at the till. If you lost the plastic card, write to support; the balance stays on your account.
faq.a4: Pick a coupon in Coupons, then enter its code in the promo-code field in your cart. The discount shows at checkout.
faq.a5: While the order has not been picked yet you can cancel it from the order page. Once a courier is on the way, contact support.
faq.a6: Levels are refreshed from how much you spend. The web app does not receive level data from the server yet, so only your bonus balance is shown.
